intro: Candidates for this exam have experience using GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) to secure code, secrets, and dependencies across the software development lifecycle. They can configure security features, triage and remediate alerts, and apply prevention-first practices using policies, workflows, and automation. Candidates are familiar with GitHub fundamentals, CI/CD, and secure development concepts.
